rows.jyutping: A ho2 ji5 jyu6 caak1 B
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when A can be used to predict B.

example.english: You can use the clouds to make a predictive judgment about whether it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 睇雲就可以預測聽日會唔會落雨。
example.jyutping: tai2 wan4 zau6 ho2 ji5 jyu6 caak1 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.traditional: A 對 B 有預測作用
rows.jyutping: A deoi3 B jau5 jyu6 caak1 zok3 jung6
rows.note: Use this when describing A's predictive function, especially in a technical or analytical context.

example.english: This model has a predictive role in forecasting stock-price movements.
example.traditional: 呢個模型對股價走勢有預測作用。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 mou4 jing4 deoi3 gu2 gaa3 zau2 sai3 jau5 jyu6 cak1 zok3 jung6
